Title: Fondue & Fort Night
Subtitle: Sweet & Savory Fondue, plus Build-Your-Own Fort
Summary: A cozy evening of fondue for all ages, fort building for the kids, and drinks for the adults
Description:
Join us for a creative and cozy evening of fondue and fort building.

For the adults, picture an elegant evening with fondue (cheese and chocolate), cocktails, and great company.

For the kids, well, didn't you hear the party about fondue?! After the fondue -- or during -- it's like the i-lab meets wilderness village meets... a backyard. We'll have plenty of blankets, lights, and building materials to turn the space into a collection of forts, nooks, mazes, and cozy hangouts.
Need To Know: Parents can come with or without kids. Unattended kids will be given sugar and tools (but drop-off is okay).
Location: The Parks' House in Los Altos

Title: Dink & Clink
Subtitle: Pickleball Mixer with Pizza and Drinks
Summary: Enjoy an adult pickleball mixer featuring a skills clinic, tournament, gourmet pizza, and drinks.
Description: Grab a paddle! We'll start with a short skills clinic for anyone new to the game, then run a friendly round-robin tournament. Gourmet pizza, beer, wine and mocktails throughout.
Need To Know: Adults only. Paddles provided, or bring your own.
Address: Smith Field Courts, 100 Kelly Ave, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019

Title: K-Pop for a Cause!
Subtitle: All-Level K-Pop Dance Workshop
Summary: All-level K-Pop dance workshop: learn a routine inspired by top K-Pop hits and dance like an idol.
Description: Learn a full routine step by step from a professional instructor, then perform it together at the end. No experience needed - just energy!
Need To Know: Bring a water bottle, comfortable shoes, and a positive attitude.

Title: Wurst Helios Party
Subtitle: Oktoberfest in the Backyard
Summary: Celebrate Oktoberfest with German beer, grilled sausages, potato pancakes, and pretzels at this cozy beer-garden gathering.
Description: Prost! An afternoon of German beer, grilled bratwurst, potato pancakes, pretzels and lively conversation under the string lights.
Location: The Marchettis' House in Mountain View

Title: Inspire Without Pressure
Subtitle: A Parent Workshop on Gifted Psychology
Summary: Led by experts on gifted psychology, this parent workshop will discuss motivation, puberty, and family communication.
Description: Two experts on gifted psychology lead a workshop on motivation without pressure, avoiding underachievement, active listening and declarative language, and the big changes of puberty. Light refreshments.

Title: Baegels and Meimosas
Subtitle: Brunch Soirée
Summary: A brunch soiree featuring bagels, fresh toppings, and sparkling mimosas.
Description: Bagels from the city, every topping you can think of, and bottomless mimosas in the garden.
Location: The Lindqvists' House in Palo Alto

Title: Sushi & Sake Soirée
Subtitle: 14-Course Omakase
Summary: Exclusive 14-course omakase sushi and sake tasting menu prepared by a private chef.
Description: A private chef prepares a 14-course omakase at our table, paired with a flight of sake. An intimate evening for twelve.
Need To Know: This party will be held with a minimum of 6 tickets sold.
Location: Carmen's House in Los Altos Hills
Address: 12 Sunset Ridge Lane, Los Altos Hills, CA 94022

Title: Fruity Drinks for Grownups
Subtitle: Brandy, Cognac and Eau de Vie
Summary: Explore the world of fruit-based spirits like brandy, cognac, and eau de vie through tasting and mixology.
Description: A guided tasting of fruit spirits from around the world, then a mixology session where you make your own.

Title: Boozy Trivia
Subtitle: Bookstore Trivia Bash
Summary: Adults-only bookstore trivia bash - boozy, brainy, mildly cutthroat, and gloriously unsupervised after hours.
Description: Literary questions, general knowledge, surprise rounds. Form your team and win prizes. Sips, snacks and bookstore shenanigans!

Title: For the Love of Helios & the Vine
Subtitle: Wine Tasting and Dinner under the Stars
Summary: Our final Helios Wine Party featuring wine tasting, dinner, and nostalgic memories of our Helios experience through the years.
Description: Gather with us for an evening of wine tasting, dinner, and community under the stars. In this final installment of our Helios wine party series, we'll take a nostalgic journey through the regions and memories we've shared together.

Title: Tees & Teas
Subtitle: Make Your Own Helios Shirt Over Teas and Snacks
Summary: Join fellow staff and parents to make your own unique Helios shirts over brunch and mimosas.
Description: We'll provide the Helios logos in an assortment of fun colors (including rainbow glitter, of course!), you'll provide your own T-shirts, sweatshirts, hoodies or totes. Sandwiches, pastries, teas and mimosas to keep you going.
Need To Know: Bring your own shirts (we'll send out recommendations).

Title: Nerf Blaster Bash
Subtitle: Nerf Party at Ortega Park
Summary: Join us at Ortega Park for a foam-filled Nerf battle extravaganza with food and drinks provided.
Description: Ready... Aim... FUN!! Get pumped for a sunny day of foam-filled excitement. Blasters and darts provided; food and drinks for everyone.
Need To Know: Ages 5+. Parents are encouraged to hang out and spectate (free), or drop off.
Address: Ortega Park, 636 Harrow Way, Sunnyvale, CA 94087

Title: Backyard Games and Goodies
Subtitle: Lawn Games and Lemonade
Summary: An afternoon of giant Jenga, cornhole, and lemonade for the whole family.
Description: Giant Jenga, cornhole, bocce, and a lemonade stand run by the kids. Bring a blanket!
Location: The Haddads' Backyard in Los Altos

Title: Crochet and Snack
Subtitle: A Cozy Crochet Circle
Summary: Learn the basics of crochet over tea and snacks.
Description: Hooks and yarn provided. Leave with a finished coaster - or the start of a scarf.

Title: Wines of the Southern Hemisphere!
Subtitle: Wine Tasting & Southern Hemisphere Dinner
Summary: Bold reds, crisp whites, and unique blends from Australia, New Zealand, Chile, and Argentina, with bites to match.
Description: Let's take a trip to the southern hemisphere - no passports needed! Non-alcoholic options too.

Title: Splash into the New Year
Subtitle: Back-to-School Pool Party
Summary: Splashing fun to welcome the new school year, with nibbles, treats, and drinks for kids and grownups.
Description: Swap those school shoes for flip flops and kick off the academic year with a splash!
